dossiers.thesis_summary: Palvella Therapeutics (Wayne PA, 14.34M shares, $2.02B cap) has one asset that matters: QTORIN 3.9% rapamycin anhydrous gel for microcystic lymphatic malformations (mLM), a rare vascular malformation with ~30,000 diagnosed US patients and ZERO FDA-approved therapies. The pivotal event already fired: Phase 3 SELVA read out positive 2026-02-24 (n=49 ITT, mean +2.13 on the mLM-IGA at Week 24, p<0.001; key secondary and all four additional secondaries also p<0.001), and the stock is up ~620% off the $36 low. What is STILL unfired is the regulatory conversion: FDA granted rolling review 2026-06-22, Palvella submitted the first NDA module 2026-06-29, and guides to COMPLETING the 505(b)(2) NDA in 2H 2026 with potential US approval and launch in 1H 2027. Breakthrough Therapy and Fast Track are in hand; $261.9M cash at 3/31/26 after the upsized $230M February raise fully funds submission, launch build-out, and the 2H26 Phase 3 start in cutaneous venous malformations (75,000 US patients) plus the Phase 2 LOTU angiokeratoma readout (2H 2027). The remaining edge is therefore regulatory/commercial conversion of an already-de-risked efficacy package, not a data event - and the milestone is a guided half-year window, not a binding date.
dossiers.kill_risk: SELVA is a SINGLE-ARM, BASELINE-CONTROLLED Phase 3 whose primary endpoint is an unblinded clinician-rated global assessment (mLM-IGA). There is no vehicle arm, so neither placebo/attention effect nor natural fluctuation of a chronic lesional disease is quantified, and the assessor was not blinded to treatment. That is exactly the package FDA can meet with a CRL demanding a controlled confirmatory trial - which would reset the timeline 2-3 years and take the equity to roughly the downside floor. Compounding it: the 2043-protected IP and $100-200k/yr pricing frame collide with compounded topical sirolimus, already used off-label at vascular-anomaly centers, so payer step-edits could cap real uptake well below the ">$1B US peak" bull frame even on approval. Secondary residual: the near-term event is only NDA COMPLETION inside an undated 2H26 window - a slip into 2027 is a de-rating (roughly the $109 200-day / pre-June levels) without any thesis break, so the position can bleed on timing alone with no falsifying news.

dossiers.dossier_note:
FACTS RE-UNDERWRITTEN (all from live record). Timeline: SELVA Ph3 topline positive 2026-02-24 (n=49 ITT, +2.13 mLM-IGA at Wk24, p<0.001; 95% [41/43] >=1-point improvement; 86% [37/43] Much/Very Much Improved). Pre-NDA meeting completed 2026-06-03. FDA granted ROLLING REVIEW 2026-06-22. First NDA module submitted 2026-06-29. Guidance unchanged across Q1 (05-07), 06-03 and 06-29 releases: complete 505(b)(2) NDA 2H 2026, potential US approval/launch 1H 2027. No slip detected - status is PENDING_SOFT, not SLIPPED. Q2 results release + call is TODAY 2026-08-04 pre-open; the Q2 8-K was filed but not yet indexed by the feeds at time of writing, so if it narrows "2H 2026" to a month or reports NDA completion, the CRO should re-read this field - that single disclosure is what converts PENDING_SOFT -> PENDING_HARD and staging true -> false. IDIOSYNCRATIC: yes; resolves on FDA action on one dossier, beta -0.165.

SHARE COUNT / CASH: 14,342,800 shares out (10-Q cover, 3/31/26), float 9.58M (66.8%) - thin. Cash+ST investments $261.9M at 3/31/26 after the $230.0M Feb-2026 raise; assuming ~$30M quarterly burn, ~$232M at 6/30/26 = ~$16/sh. EV at $140.78 = $2.019B - $0.232B = ~$1.79B.

WIN LEG ARITHMETIC (fair_value_target $195): 30,000 diagnosed US mLM patients x 15-20% steady-state treated penetration = 4,500-6,000 patients x ~$120k net = $540-720M risk-adjusted US peak (company/street bull frame is ">$1B" at $100-200k pricing; the conservative published frame is ">$200M" - I use the middle and do NOT underwrite the $1B). At 3-4x EV/peak for a de-risked, first-in-disease orphan launch with IP into 2043: $1.6-2.9B. Add ~$0.4B partial credit for cutaneous VM (75,000 US patients, Ph3 starting 2H26, TOIVA Ph2 bleeding endpoint +2.5 pts p=0.003) and token value for angiokeratoma/QTORIN pitavastatin. Total EV $2.0-3.3B + $0.23B net cash = $2.13-3.43B equity / 14.343M sh = $149-239/sh, midpoint ~$194. Round to $195, which also sits on the 12-analyst mean PT of $197.08 (high $270, low $133).

LOSE LEG ARITHMETIC (downside_floor $55): CRL demanding a randomized controlled confirmatory trial. $55 x 14.343M = $789M equity - $232M cash = ~$557M residual EV for a program with demonstrated (if uncontrolled) efficacy, three follow-on indications and funded runway. Explicitly NOT the $36 52-week low: that print is pre-Phase-3 and pre-$230M raise, and with XBI at multi-year highs old max-fear floors on de-risked rare-disease names are stale-low. A mere TIMING slip (NDA into 2027) is a shallower ~$100-110 outcome, not the floor.

RESULTING GEOMETRY: EV = 0.80 x 195 + 0.20 x 55 = $167 vs $140.78 spot = +18.6%. R:R = (195 - 140.78)/(140.78 - 55) = 54.22/85.78 = 0.63:1. Positive EV but sub-1 reward/risk - the 620% run has already banked most of the de-risking, which is the honest read the Director should size against.

TAKEOUT LENS (bio/pharma, applied and DECLINED as a lift). Profile fits the 2026 regime precisely: late-stage, commercially ready, first-in-disease, US-only build, single-platform, ~$2B cap, no approved competitor. Plausible acquirers: Incyte (rare/inflammatory derm buyer, actively deploying) and a derm pure-play such as Galderma or Sun Pharma. COMP WITH PROVENANCE: Incyte / Vega Therapeutics (Star Therapeutics subsidiary), announced June 2026, $1.25B upfront and up to $2.0B with milestones, for VGA039 - a PHASE 3 rare bleeding-disorder asset with Breakthrough Therapy and rare-pediatric-disease designations. PVLA is regulatorily LATER than that comp, but its $2.02B market cap ALREADY exceeds the comp's $1.25B upfront and equals its full $2.0B biodollar value. So the best available recent comp does not support lifting the win leg above $195; a takeout at a typical 40-60% premium ($197-225) lands inside the existing win-leg band. Takeout is therefore undated optionality consistent with - not additive to - the target, and no milestone is created from it.

DECK-MARK GATE: not applicable (no commodity/feasibility-study price deck in this thesis).

passed.passed_because: No admissible expression exists, and the resolving event is outside the sleeve's horizon. (1) valuation_method=binary_prob mandates DEFINED-RISK ONLY (debit_spread or defined_risk_option, hard validator gate), but the CRO's live check shows the chain is untradeable — only four expirations list, the furthest (2027-02-19) carries 0-1 contracts of open interest, zero volume and no two-sided quote (isValid:false) — and staging=true independently forbids options on an undated catalyst. Equity, the one structure the CRO will accept, is exactly what the binary gate prohibits, so every available expression breaches a hard rule. (2) The resolution_driver is FDA_approval_decision and the guided approval/launch is 1H 2027; only NDA COMPLETION falls inside 2026, and that is a re-rating step, not the value-resolving fork — a 2027 resolution path is a pass on merit under the fast-return horizon. (3) The CRO's own remedy was 'size as a staging half-seat, not a full catalyst seat', and under equal weight that lever no longer exists: seating it forces a full 50/9 seat on an undated name with 0.63:1 reward/risk, a downside leg worth 61% of capital, and a non-falsifying timing-slip outcome at ~$109-110 (-22%). (4) The board mark ($118.84, asof 2026-06-23) is 6 weeks stale and 18.5% below live $140.78 — the rolling-review grant and first-module submission are already paid for, and the CRO caps entry at $141.00 with a mechanical kill at $161, i.e. zero room to pay up. Accountability: I nominated PVLA on 2026-06-23 at +59.1% expected and I am withdrawing it on this fresh look, not on headroom — nothing caps it. It earns a re-nomination the moment the NDA completes and a dated milestone with a liquid defined-risk chain exists, or the price resets toward the $109-119 area and restores reward/risk above 1:1.

Nothing was breached because nothing was added.

The single survivor, PVLA, was my own prior nomination and I am withdrawing it on merit — headroom was never the issue. The disqualifier is structural, not a judgement call: it is a binary_prob name, which the validator says must be defined-risk only, while staging=true forbids options and the chain is genuinely untradeable (0-1 contracts of open interest on the furthest expiry, no two-sided quote). There is no legal way to express it. Layered on top: the resolving event is the FDA approval decision guided to 1H 2027, outside the within-2026 horizon; the board mark was 6 weeks and 18.5% stale, so the rolling-review and first-module de-risking is already in the price; reward/risk at the live $140.78 is 0.63:1 with a 61%-of-capital downside leg; and today's unread Q2 release still gates the entry. Under conviction-proportional sizing the CRO's 'staging half-seat' would have been the right answer. Under equal weight that answer does not exist — the choice is a full seat that dilutes all eight held names or nothing, and this one is not as good as the median seat I already hold.

Debt-cycle judgement (DISCIPLINE, advisory — this did not gate anything, the expression rule and the horizon did): the catalyst families getting paid in this phase are the ones that convert to cash soon — approvals with launch revenue landing inside the window, closing deals, forced sellers. PVLA's cash is a 1H-2027 launch at the earliest; it is a distant terminal-value re-rate fighting a rising real 30y, and the guided-half-year window means it can bleed on timing alone with no falsifying news. That reinforces a decision I would have made anyway on the expression gate. The record biotech M&A tape does not rescue it either — the CRO applied the takeout lens and declined it explicitly, because the $2.02B cap already exceeds the best-provenance comp's $1.25B upfront, so a 40-60% premium lands inside the existing $195 win leg rather than above it. That is the warm-tape trap the regime block warns about, and it is the correct read.
